_doc: SPD-17: round-trip cost WITH DATA. Per GET route the web calls: trips and p50/p95 ms at 0 / 1,000 / 10,000 extra rows per main table (tests/support/seed-volume.cjs, local scratch DB). p95_ceiling = p95 x 1.5 (at least +50 ms). grows:true = trips rise with rows (an SPD-n backlog line each). Lower with node tools/round-trips-volume.cjs --write; never raise without the reason in the commit.

GET /api/catalogue/network/:bridge_id.why: live cost grows with the departments or stores (18 to 20 trips each); the stub cannot reach it

POST /api/catalogue/network-store/:netwo.why: live cost grows with the departments or stores (18 to 20 trips each); the stub cannot reach it

GET /api/catalogue/network-store/:networ.why: one read per department or store (rows stub 27 / 72 / 522)

GET /api/tax/gstr.why: lib/tax-copy.js:600-607 awaits per bill inside the loop (one identities read per bill)

GET /api/till/snapshot.why: routes/till.js:1150 resolves each adopted item in its own read (small N)

stub_artefacts.GET /api/products: the generic stub row has no real item shape, so the per-row work the route does on it is not a real loop (reviewed in api PR 1139)
